observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same black rectangular console with a textured, scratched plastic cover on top, resembling a protective film or skin.
The console has a slim profile, consistent with a PS4 Slim model.
A black PlayStation controller is placed in front of the console, with visible buttons and analog sticks.
Cables are visible: a power cord with a two-prong plug and what appears to be an HDMI or USB cable.
The console is placed on a light-colored fabric surface.
No branding or model labels are visible on the console or controller in either photo.
The seller's watermark 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES POSTED ON JIJI' is overlaid on both photos.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim console with controller and cables

claims.evidence: No visible model or capacity label on the console. The slim profile matches a PS4 Slim, but 1TB cannot be confirmed from photos.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the console covered in a heavily scratched, wrinkled plastic film, which suggests wear or damage, not cleanliness.
No screen or interface shown to verify installed games. Cannot be confirmed from photos.

risks.risk: Console may not be 1TB or may be a different model (e.g., PS4 Pro or original PS4)
risks.proof: Photo showing the model label on the back or side of the console, or a screenshot of the system settings showing storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4 Slim with unknown capacity, which may be less than 1TB.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or system menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since 'works' is unproven.

risks.risk: Games are not actually installed or are pirated/illegal copies
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 home screen showing the 20 games listed, or a video of gameplay from one of the games.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without the game value, as games are unverified.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or damaged
risks.proof: Video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controller may not work.

proof_requests: Photo of the back or side of the console showing the model label and storage capacity.
Video of the console powering on and showing the system menu or a game running.
Screenshot or video of the PS4 home screen showing the 20 installed games.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and functioning.
response.reason: The console's model and storage capacity cannot be confirmed from the photos, and the claim of 20 installed games is unverifiable. The 'very clean' claim is contradicted by the scratched plastic cover. Without proof of functionality and specifications, a worst-case price cannot be determined.
